Hello Priya,

I saw the UI/UX Designer posting for Artikate Studio and wanted to reach out because your focus on the power of engineering to do good aligns directly with how I approach product design as a computer science graduate.

At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated user findings into cleaner user flows and wireframes. At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable visual systems and 100+ digital and print creatives that cut turnaround time across teams.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates an end-to-end B2B verification experience focused on reducing friction for users. You can review my work at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Could we take five minutes next week to review my Bounceless case study?

Ananya

2.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Mobile UI/UX Designer and noticed you need someone experienced in designing mobile applications and working closely with development teams.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing, built wireframes, and collaborated directly with developers on design-to-development handoff for startups and SMBs. I also bring a B.Tech in Computer Science, which helps me understand technical feasibility and collaborate smoothly with engineers on implementation.

You can see my end-to-end UX process in my Bounceless case study, a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, which is available on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to taking a look at that case study, or a quick chat about how my background fits your team?

Ananya
